items.title: How much of a polling loop's cost is pure waste?
items.description: The unit's scenario has Orders polling Shipping once a second for one order's status. Real shipments are much rarer than that — nearly every poll finds nothing new. Drag the poll interval and how long the order actually takes to ship to see how many requests that loop makes before it finally finds the real change (86,400/day at the scenario's own 1-second interval).

params.name: hoursUntilShipped
params.label: Hours until the order actually ships

items.compute: const wastedPolls = Math.max(0, Math.round((params.hoursUntilShipped * 3600) / params.pollIntervalSeconds) - 1); return { wastedPolls };

outputs.label: Wasted requests before the real change is seen

items.title: How stale can a CQRS read model get under load?
items.description: In the L2 walkthrough, a projector consumes events and updates a read model asynchronously — the dashboard is accurate a little after the write, not instantly. Drag how many events are queued up and how fast the projector processes them to see the worst-case staleness a reader could observe on the dashboard.

params.name: queuedEvents
params.label: Events currently queued for the projector

items.compute: const staleSeconds = Math.round((params.queuedEvents / params.eventsPerSecond) * 100) / 100; return { staleSeconds };
